name: veil-extension
description: Veil browser extension (Chrome MV3). No build step: load this folder unpacked.

scripts.package: cd .. && rm -f frontend/public/downloads/veil-extension.zip && mkdir -p frontend/public/downloads && zip -qr frontend/public/downloads/veil-extension.zip extension -x 'extension/test/*' 'extension/package.json' 'extension/node_modules/*'
